description: This is a Svelte component source file that implements a task management board list interface, including fetching, display, creation, renaming, deletion, and reordering of boards with drag-and-drop support.

methods.name: initBoards
methods.description: Initializes the board list by fetching data from API and setting the order and selection.

methods.name: handleCreateBoard
methods.description: Handles creation of a new board with current title and description inputs.

methods.name: startRename
methods.description: Sets renaming state for a specific board.

methods.name: handleRenameBoard
methods.description: Sends update request to rename the specified board.

methods.name: handleDeleteBoard
methods.description: Deletes a board after user confirmation.

methods.name: handleDnd
methods.description: Handles drag-and-drop reordering of boards and updates their order via API.
